feature: Setelah eNotification sukses, notice offender yang ID-nya ada di tabel HST otomatis di-TS-HST (lookup ocms_hst batch lalu applyTsHstSuspension dengan retry sekali)
note: Ditemukan saat menelusuri OCMS11.4/11.5. Setelah SMS atau email terkirim, job mengecek ID di ocms_hst dan menerapkan TS-HST. Teks OCMS11.4/11.5 tidak menyebut aturan ini; mungkin dicakup story suspension epic lain yang tidak diperiksa di chunk ini. Karena cron eNotification enabled=false, aturan ini juga ikut tidak jalan.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS11.4/11.5. After an SMS or email is sent, the job checks the ID in ocms_hst and applies TS-HST. The OCMS11.4/11.5 text does not mention this rule; it may be covered by a suspension-epic story that was not checked in this chunk. Because the eNotification cron is enabled=false, this rule does not run either.

feature: Email ringkasan batch SMS dan email kegagalan batch ke tim ops (sendSmsBatchSummaryEmail, sendBatchFailureEmail dengan lampiran CSV yang dikirim ke Postman2)
note: Ditemukan saat menelusuri OCMS11.4. Setiap batch SMS memicu email ringkasan, dan batch gagal memicu email kegagalan dengan CSV lampiran, memakai template SMS_BATCH_SUMMARY dan SMS_BATCH_FAILURE dari DB. Story OCMS11.4 hanya meminta pengiriman SMS; laporan harian eNotification ada di OCMS9.9 dan mungkin tidak mencakup email per batch ini.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS11.4. Every SMS batch triggers a summary email, and a failed batch triggers a failure email with a CSV attachment, using the DB templates SMS_BATCH_SUMMARY and SMS_BATCH_FAILURE. OCMS11.4 only asks for sending the SMS; the daily eNotification report is in OCMS9.9 and may not cover this per-batch email.
